name: Iskusstvo trebuyet zhertv
source:
A short story of the difficult fate of a musician. A selfless vocalist gives his all on stage, and there is only one thing that gives him the strength to continue his work.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2485601512]Steam[/url]]
